value.rationale: On a natural heterogeneous graph family encompassing multi-wing windmills and friendship graphs, the theorem counts every successful local forcing seed (not merely a minimum) and gives a closed probabilistic forcing function. It proves the global colour-cover obstruction at the centre and a parity-sensitive exact real-root count, meaningful invariants not supplied by chromatic number or generic graph-polynomial complexity. The uniformly valid infinite-family classification provides reusable exact data for forcing-colouring investigations.
